notes: SKU text keeps KraftMaid punctuation (dots kept) but spaces are removed, matching the book's own order examples (e.g. "W3030BUTT-HFVEB", "OC332484BUTTC"); the only kept space is inside fractions ("WEP1 1/2.30").

"R or L" (also "RR or RL", "LR or LL") is removed from the SKU and recorded as hinge:true; orderPattern shows where the hand letter goes (e.g. "B12{R|L}.DXFWT" -> B12R.DXFWT, as in the book example "B12L-APFC").
"(Butt)" in parentheses is informational in the book and is dropped from the SKU (noted in note); "BUTT" in capitals is part of the code and is kept.
Legend symbols printed before SKUs (r, m, u, ;, :, i, s, n, H, etc.) are stripped; where the block defines them, their meaning is copied into the SKU note.

Dimensions are W x H x D in inches. Cabinet SKUs encode W, D, H in that order when there are three numbers (e.g. U152484 = 15w x 24d x 84h, VB121831 = 12w x 18d x 31.5h); two numbers are W,H for wall/tall and W,D for base/vanity/desk. Heights are reconciled with the book's printed heights ("23 1/2\" High", "34 1/2\"", "31 1/2\"", "88 1/2\"").

dimSource lists any dimension that was not read from the SKU or a printed size: "default" = standard KraftMaid box size (wall 12d, base 34.5h x 24d, tall 24d, vanity 21d) used only when the SKU/page did not state it; "drawing" = first single dimension label on the product drawing.

Panels/fillers: w = first number in the code (filler width, stile width, or panel face width), h = height; thickness (d) is usually not given. Moldings: w = length in inches when the code gives feet (ACM8 = 96). Hardware, accessories, trays and shelf kits carry no dimensions (null).

options = construction-option chart codes marked available (filled bullet = upcharge, v = standard, I = with exceptions; blank = not available). optionsStandard and optionsWithExceptions break that down.
No prices are printed in this book; only the Order Upcharge % Guide (PDF p10) percentages are included.
page = PDF page number (1-based); pageLabel = printed page label (e.g. F2).
